Railway RRB JE CBT I Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released Exam Date for the recruitment of Junior Engineer JE, CMA & DMS on the official website of the RRBs. This recruitment was released for 4029 posts. Applications for the RRB Junior Engineer JE Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 14 August 2026 to 13 September 2026. The CBT-I examination is going to conducted on 27, 28 & 30 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Railway RRB JE CBT I Exam Date 2026 from the link given below.
